COMMENT " Every statement kind, plus comment placement." [1]
CONST HERO := "Alex" [2]
CONST MAX_TRIES: int = 3 [3]
VAR gold: int = 10 [4]
VAR flags: Array[String] = [] [5]
VAR unset [6]
BLANK [7]
BEAT main [8]
  VAR local := 1 #" temporary" [9]
  NARRATION "Narration with a trailing comment." #" note" [10]
  DIALOGUE jonas "A long line\nthat spans two lines." [11-12]
  DIALOGUE mira (face=smile, outfit=coat) "Single quotes work too." [13]
  DIALOGUE @id("main_04") @voice("mira_004") mira "Pinned id and voice." [14]
  ANNOTATION @id("main_05") [15]
  NARRATION "Annotation on its own line." [16]
  ASSIGN gold -= 2 [17]
  EXPRESSION (call (. flags append) "met_jonas") [18]
  ASSIGN ([] inventory "key") = true [19]
  EXPRESSION (await (call wait 0.5)) [20]
  EXPRESSION (call side_quest) [21]
  EXPRESSION (call (. other_tale intro)) [22]
  IF (> gold 5) [23]
    JUMP rich [23] inline
  ELIF (== gold 0) [24]
    PASS [25]
  ELSE [26]
    DIALOGUE mira "Hmm." [27]
  WHILE (< gold MAX_TRIES) [28]
    ASSIGN gold += 1 [29]
    IF (== gold 2) [30]
      CONTINUE [31]
    BREAK [32]
  FOR item: String in flags [33]
    EXPRESSION (call emit "item" item) [34]
  MATCH gold [35]
    MATCH_BRANCH 0 1 [36]
      NARRATION "Broke." [37]
    MATCH_BRANCH 2 when (not (call (. flags is_empty))) [38]
      NARRATION "Two and flagged." [39]
    MATCH_BRANCH _ [40]
      NARRATION "Something else." [40] inline
  CHOOSE (call choose style="hotspots" timeout=5.0) [41]
    OPTION @once "Ask about the key" [42]
      DIALOGUE mira "I lost it." [43]
    OPTION "Leave" if (call has_item "map") [44]
      JUMP exit [44] inline
    TIMEOUT [45]
      NARRATION "Too slow." [46]
  RETURN [47]
BLANK [48]
BEAT side_quest [49]
  NARRATION "Side quest." [50]
  COMMENT " indented comment stays in this beat" [51]
  BLANK [52]
  RETURN 5 [53]
BLANK [54]
COMMENT " trailing comment at the end of the file" [55]
